t: This is the Vagina Museum, the world's first brick and mortar museum about the female reproductive system. It began in Camden Market in October 2019, then moved to Bethnal Green in March 2022. It reopened in November 2023 in two railway arches in Bethnal Green, its long-term home. The founder, Florence Schechter, was its director from 2017 to 2024. She is a British activist, and has also been a Green Party councillor in Hackney.
